slots.name: event status
slots.sentence: House Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.) canceled an upcoming event affiliated with Cornell University amid fresh scrutiny of how the Ivy League institution handled a 2024 allegation of gang rape on its campus.

slots.name: event date
slots.sentence: A source close to the Democratic lawmaker told The Hill that the Oct. 15 event in New York City with the Cornell Institute of Politics and Global Affairs (IOPGA) was canceled due to “the horrific sexual assault allegations and serious concerns about Cornell’s response.”
